name: City Coach: Paratransit
fullDescription: Vacaville City Coach provides Origin to Destination ADA paratransit for people who cannot use regular City Coach bus service due to a disability.
whatTheyOffer:
- Origin-to-destination shared ride service
- Service within Vacaville city limits, during the same days and hours as City Coach buses
- Advance reservations required
- One-way ADA fare $2; 20-ride punch pass $39
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Call 707-541-7184 (weekdays) to schedule an in-person eligibility assessment
2. Complete the in-person assessment
3. You'll get a determination letter within 21 days
4. Once certified, schedule rides by phone
keywords: City Coach, paratransit, ADA, Vacaville, Solano County, disability, wheelchair, door to door
